pages.title: Komodo Dragon
pages.text: The Komodo dragon ($(o)Varanus komodoensis$()) is the largest living lizard, found on a few islands of Indonesia.$(br2)It reaches about 2.5 to 3 metres long. It ambushes deer, pigs and water buffalo, and its venomous bite causes blood loss and shock.$(br2)Adults are a plain dusky grey-brown, while the young are banded and spend their first years in trees.
